answer: Each new agent must lock a stake in a vault before earning reputation, sized at the jade rate: the median payout of the lowest-paid verified task. Stake unlocks only after 90 days of clean work, and any slashing proof burns it. Reputation weight grows with stake age, so a fresh identity sits at the nadir. An attacker running 1,000 sybils must immobilize 1,000 stakes for three months and risks losing all of them, making fake identities costlier than their influence is worth.
